requirements.original: The ports of a test component can be connected to ports of other components or to the ports of the test system interface (see figure 10).
requirements.canonical: A port of a test component CAN be connected to ports of other test components or to ports of the test system interface.
requirements.header: // @requirement: 21.1.0 -- The ports of a test component can be connected to ports of other components or to the ports of the test system interface (see figure 10).

requirements.original: In the case of connections between two test components, the connect operation shall be used.
requirements.canonical: For a connection between two test components, the `connect` operation SHALL be used.
requirements.condition: ports of two test components are connected
requirements.header: // @requirement: 21.1.0 -- In the case of connections between two test components, the connect operation shall be used.

requirements.original: When connecting a test component to a test system interface the map operation shall be used.
requirements.canonical: When connecting a test component to the test system interface, the `map` operation SHALL be used.
requirements.condition: a test component port is connected to the test system interface
requirements.header: // @requirement: 21.1.0 -- When connecting a test component to a test system interface the map operation shall be used.

requirements.original: The connect operation directly connects one port to another with the in side connected to the out side and vice versa.
requirements.canonical: The `connect` operation directly connects one port to another port, with the in side of each port connected to the out side of the other port.
requirements.header: // @requirement: 21.1.0 -- The connect operation directly connects one port to another with the in side connected to the out side and vice versa.

requirements.original: The connect operation is used to setup connections between test components.
requirements.canonical: The `connect` operation sets up a connection between ports of test components.
requirements.header: // @requirement: 21.1.1 -- The connect operation is used to setup connections between test components.

requirements.original: The map operation are used to setup connections to the SUT.
requirements.canonical: The `map` operation sets up a mapping between a port of a test component and a port of the test system interface towards the SUT.

improper_terms.proper: mapping to a port of the test system interface

ambiguity.issue: The sentence calls the result of a map operation a 'connection to the SUT', while the standard otherwise distinguishes connections (connect) from mappings (map) to the test system interface.

requirements.header: // @requirement: 21.1.1 -- The map operation are used to setup connections to the SUT.

requirements.canonical: The `connect` operation has the syntax connect ( ComponentRef : Port , ComponentRef : Port ).
requirements.header: // @requirement: 21.1.1 -- connect "(" ComponentRef ":" Port "," ComponentRef ":" Port ")" map "(" ComponentRef ":" Port "," ComponentRef ":" Port ")" [ param "(" [ { ActualPar [","] }+ ] ")" ]

requirements.canonical: The `map` operation has the syntax map ( ComponentRef : Port , ComponentRef : Port ) optionally followed by a param clause param ( [ ActualPar { , ActualPar } ] ).
requirements.header: // @requirement: 21.1.1 -- connect "(" ComponentRef ":" Port "," ComponentRef ":" Port ")" map "(" ComponentRef ":" Port "," ComponentRef ":" Port ")" [ param "(" [ { ActualPar [","] }+ ] ")" ]

requirements.original: With both the connect operation and the map operation, the ports to be connected are identified by the component references of the components to be connected and the names of the ports to be connected.
requirements.canonical: In a `connect` or `map` operation, each port to be connected IS identified by the component reference of its component and the port name.
requirements.header: // @requirement: 21.1.1 -- With both the connect operation and the map operation, the ports to be connected are identified by the component references of the components to be connected and the names of the ports to be connected.

requirements.original: The operation mtc identifies the MTC, the operation system identifies the test system interface and the operation self identifies the test component in which self has been called (see clause 6.2.11).
requirements.canonical: The `mtc` operation identifies the MTC.
requirements.header: // @requirement: 21.1.1 -- The operation mtc identifies the MTC, the operation system identifies the test system interface and the operation self identifies the test component in which self has been called (see clause 6.2.11).

requirements.original: The operation mtc identifies the MTC, the operation system identifies the test system interface and the operation self identifies the test component in which self has been called (see clause 6.2.11).
requirements.canonical: The `system` operation identifies the test system interface.
requirements.header: // @requirement: 21.1.1 -- The operation mtc identifies the MTC, the operation system identifies the test system interface and the operation self identifies the test component in which self has been called (see clause 6.2.11).

requirements.original: The operation mtc identifies the MTC, the operation system identifies the test system interface and the operation self identifies the test component in which self has been called (see clause 6.2.11).
requirements.canonical: The `self` operation identifies the test component in which `self` has been called.
requirements.header: // @requirement: 21.1.1 -- The operation mtc identifies the MTC, the operation system identifies the test system interface and the operation self identifies the test component in which self has been called (see clause 6.2.11).

requirements.original: All these operations can be used for identifying and connecting ports.
requirements.canonical: The `mtc`, `system` and `self` operations MAY be used as component references for identifying and connecting ports.
requirements.header: // @requirement: 21.1.1 -- All these operations can be used for identifying and connecting ports.

requirements.original: Both the connect and map operations shall be only invoked from places specified in clause 21.0.
requirements.canonical: The `connect` operation SHALL only be invoked from the places specified in clause 21.0.
requirements.header: // @requirement: 21.1.1 -- Both the connect and map operations shall be only invoked from places specified in clause 21.0.

requirements.original: Both the connect and map operations shall be only invoked from places specified in clause 21.0.
requirements.canonical: The `map` operation SHALL only be invoked from the places specified in clause 21.0.
requirements.header: // @requirement: 21.1.1 -- Both the connect and map operations shall be only invoked from places specified in clause 21.0.

requirements.original: Before either operation is called, the components to be connected shall have been created and their component references shall be known together with the names of the relevant ports.
requirements.canonical: Before a `connect` or `map` operation is called, the test components to be connected SHALL have been created.
requirements.header: // @requirement: 21.1.1 -- Before either operation is called, the components to be connected shall have been created and their component references shall be known together with the names of the relevant ports.

requirements.original: Before either operation is called, the components to be connected shall have been created and their component references shall be known together with the names of the relevant ports.
requirements.canonical: Before a `connect` or `map` operation is called, the component references of the test components to be connected and the names of the relevant ports SHALL be known.
requirements.header: // @requirement: 21.1.1 -- Before either operation is called, the components to be connected shall have been created and their component references shall be known together with the names of the relevant ports.

requirements.original: Applying a map or connect operation to ports which are already mapped or connected has no effect on the test behaviour or test configuration, i.e. test execution continues as if the operation has not been invoked.
requirements.canonical: Applying a `connect` or `map` operation to ports which are already connected or mapped to each other has no effect on the test behaviour or test configuration, and test execution continues as if the operation had not been invoked.

readings: Applying a `connect` or `map` operation to a pair of ports between which the same connection or mapping already exists has no effect.
Applying a `connect` or `map` operation to ports of which either one already has any connection or mapping has no effect.
ambiguity.issue: 'ports which are already mapped or connected' does not say whether the existing connection must be between the same two ports; since a port may have several connections, the first reading (identical connection already exists) was chosen.

requirements.header: // @requirement: 21.1.1 -- Applying a map or connect operation to ports which are already mapped or connected has no effect on the test behaviour or test configuration, i.e. test execution continues as if the operation has not been invoked.

requirements.original: The map operation provides an optional parameter list for configuration purposes.
requirements.canonical: A `map` operation MAY contain an optional parameter list (param clause) for configuration purposes.
requirements.header: // @requirement: 21.1.1 -- The map operation provides an optional parameter list for configuration purposes.

requirements.original: If a parameter list is present, the actual parameters shall conform to the map **param** clause of the port type declaration of the system port used.
requirements.canonical: If a param clause is present in a `map` operation, its actual parameters SHALL conform to the map param clause of the port type declaration of the system port used.
requirements.condition: the map operation has a parameter list
requirements.header: // @requirement: 21.1.1 -- If a parameter list is present, the actual parameters shall conform to the map **param** clause of the port type declaration of the system port used.

requirements.original: a) For both the connect and map operations, only consistent connections are allowed.
requirements.canonical: A `connect` or `map` operation SHALL only establish consistent connections.
requirements.header: // @requirement: 21.1.1 -- a) For both the connect and map operations, only consistent connections are allowed.

requirements.original: b) The connect operation is allowed if and only if:
requirements.canonical: A `connect` operation MAY be applied if outlist-PORT1 ⊆ inlist-PORT2, outlist-PORT2 ⊆ inlist-PORT1, neither PORT1 nor PORT2 is a system port reference, and at least one of outlist-PORT1 or outlist-PORT2 is not empty.
requirements.header: // @requirement: 21.1.1 -- b) The connect operation is allowed if and only if:

requirements.original: 1) outlist-PORT1 ⊆ inlist-PORT2 and outlist-PORT2 ⊆ inlist-PORT1; and
requirements.canonical: In a `connect` operation, outlist-PORT1 SHALL be a subset of inlist-PORT2.
requirements.header: // @requirement: 21.1.1 -- 1) outlist-PORT1 ⊆ inlist-PORT2 and outlist-PORT2 ⊆ inlist-PORT1; and

requirements.original: 1) outlist-PORT1 ⊆ inlist-PORT2 and outlist-PORT2 ⊆ inlist-PORT1; and
requirements.canonical: In a `connect` operation, outlist-PORT2 SHALL be a subset of inlist-PORT1.
requirements.header: // @requirement: 21.1.1 -- 1) outlist-PORT1 ⊆ inlist-PORT2 and outlist-PORT2 ⊆ inlist-PORT1; and

requirements.original: 2) neither PORT1 nor PORT2 are system port references; and
requirements.canonical: Neither port of a `connect` operation SHALL be a system port reference.
requirements.header: // @requirement: 21.1.1 -- 2) neither PORT1 nor PORT2 are system port references; and

requirements.original: 3) atleast one of outlist-PORT1 or outlist-PORT2 is not empty.
requirements.canonical: In a `connect` operation, at least one of outlist-PORT1 or outlist-PORT2 SHALL NOT be empty.
requirements.header: // @requirement: 21.1.1 -- 3) atleast one of outlist-PORT1 or outlist-PORT2 is not empty.

requirements.original: c) The map operation is allowed if and only if:
requirements.canonical: A `map` operation MAY be applied if one port is a component port reference and the other a system port reference, outlist-PORT1 ⊆ outlist-PORT2, inlist-PORT2 ⊆ inlist-PORT1, and at least one of outlist-PORT1 or inlist-PORT2 is not empty.
requirements.header: // @requirement: 21.1.1 -- c) The map operation is allowed if and only if:

requirements.original: 1) PORT1 is a component port reference and PORT2 is a system port reference; and
requirements.canonical: In a `map` operation, one port (PORT1) SHALL be a component port reference and the other port (PORT2) SHALL be a system port reference.
requirements.header: // @requirement: 21.1.1 -- 1) PORT1 is a component port reference and PORT2 is a system port reference; and

requirements.original: 2) outlist-PORT1 ⊆ outlist-PORT2 and inlist-PORT2 ⊆ inlist-PORT1; and
requirements.canonical: In a `map` operation, outlist-PORT1 of the component port SHALL be a subset of outlist-PORT2 of the system port.
requirements.header: // @requirement: 21.1.1 -- 2) outlist-PORT1 ⊆ outlist-PORT2 and inlist-PORT2 ⊆ inlist-PORT1; and

requirements.original: 2) outlist-PORT1 ⊆ outlist-PORT2 and inlist-PORT2 ⊆ inlist-PORT1; and
requirements.canonical: In a `map` operation, inlist-PORT2 of the system port SHALL be a subset of inlist-PORT1 of the component port.
requirements.header: // @requirement: 21.1.1 -- 2) outlist-PORT1 ⊆ outlist-PORT2 and inlist-PORT2 ⊆ inlist-PORT1; and

requirements.original: 3) at least one of outlist-PORT1 or inlist-PORT2 is not empty.
requirements.canonical: In a `map` operation, at least one of outlist-PORT1 or inlist-PORT2 SHALL NOT be empty.
requirements.header: // @requirement: 21.1.1 -- 3) at least one of outlist-PORT1 or inlist-PORT2 is not empty.
